contexts.content:

Title: Evaluation Chickpea Bowl app-02 1f6dc2b9-4843-4be3-a49a-23035748cde6
Section: ingredients

* 250 g drained canned chickpeas
* 200 g cooked rice
* 1 tbsp olive oil
* 1 tsp ground cumin

Document: evaluation-app-02-1f6dc2b9-4843-4be3-a49a-23035748cde6.md
Title: Evaluation Chickpea Bowl app-02 1f6dc2b9-4843-4be3-a49a-23035748cde6
Section: steps

1. Heat the olive oil in a pan.
2. Add the drained chickpeas and ground cumin. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
3. Add the already cooked rice and stir for 2 minutes.
4. Divide into 2 servings.
